# Aspire Integrations Map (Level 3)

## Use this doc when
A user asks what integration category to use, or needs links to Aspire integration areas.

## Categories from Aspire main docs
- Get Started
  - Setup/tooling
  - Service discovery
  - Service defaults
  - Dashboard
- Storage integrations
  - Azure Blob Storage
  - Azure Storage Queues
  - Azure Table Storage
- Database integrations
  - SQL Server
  - PostgreSQL
  - Azure Cosmos DB
  - MySQL
  - MongoDB
  - EF Core variants/migrations
- Messaging integrations
  - Azure Event Hubs
  - Azure Service Bus
  - Azure Web PubSub
  - RabbitMQ
  - Apache Kafka
  - NATS
- Caching integrations
  - Redis (caching/output/distributed)
- Framework integrations
  - Orleans
  - Dapr
- Deployment
  - Deployment overview
  - ACA deployment path
  - Custom deployment pipelines

## Selection guidance
- If user goal is local orchestration and service wiring, start with service discovery + service defaults.
- If user goal is app visibility, include dashboard guidance early.
- If user asks for production push, route to deployment docs and clarify preview command caveats.
